address: place de la Résistance 1, Baudour, 7331, Belgium
bio: (Temporarily closed due to renovation works) Éric Fernez inherited his love of cooking from his grand-mother, Eugénie, and he has passed on this passion to his daughter, Émilie. Premium produce, generous classical fare and the added dimension that wine can bring to a dish are the bedrock of this family’s values. Éric, a past master of old school cooking, crafts nostalgic food that reads like a culinary encyclopaedia. You can expect to sample traditional produce, like pigeon, pig’s trotters and sole (à la Fernand Point, no less!), courtesy of almost-forgotten recipes. The sauces are in a class of their own, illustrated by a consommé of beef tail that flanks trout, cooked medium rare, or the gutsy duck gravy that escorts duck breast and an amazing caramelised nougat.
